fields.acceptance: A testscript with fixture journals and change sets: a failed run and a gave-up run each on a landed, a withdrawn, a rejected and a superseded change set, and one of each on an accepted change set, lists exactly the accepted-change-set items in text and --json; a run on a change set the log does not know stays listed; a question and a sign-off on a landed change set stay listed
fields.statement: rhiza inbox leaves out a failed run or a run the daemon gave up on whose change set has landed, been withdrawn, rejected or superseded, so every item it lists names a next command that can succeed on its change set; questions and sign-offs stay listed

fields.acceptance: A testscript fails a fake run, abandons it with exit 0, and shows failed with the abandoned-by detail in run status and --json; rhiza inbox no longer lists the run; resume and resume --retry exit 2 naming it; a second abandon exits 2; abandoning a succeeded run exits 2 as finished
fields.statement: rhiza run abandon also takes a failed run: it journals the run as abandoned by the actor, so the inbox stops listing it and rhiza run resume refuses it, naming the run; a succeeded run is still refused as finished
